text.城南五山エリアの一つである、御殿山の閑静な住宅街に位置する低層マンションのリフォ: A renovation in a low-rise block in the quiet residential streets of Gotenyama, one of the Jonan Gozan districts. Reworking the plan substantially around the couple's way of living opened the apartment out and gave it room to breathe. Beyond the air that lime plaster walls and solid teak flooring bring, it is the greenery and the moving air coming through the wooden shutters at the windows that make the living room a calm, finely made place where time runs slowly. The limestone niche at the entrance has adjustable shelf heights, so that seasonal flowers or a display can be set out.
text.リビングの窓に設置したウッドシャッターは、光の入り方を調整するだけでなくカーテン: The wooden shutters at the living-room windows not only control how the light enters; unlike curtains or blinds they do not flap in a breeze, so the air from outside can be let in freely.
